positive.prompt: Download NSE bhavcopy for 2015 to 2025 and build a split- and bonus-adjusted close series.
My NSE bhavcopy downloader stopped getting files in July 2024. What changed?
Parse the subject field of the NSE corporate-actions API to extract split and bonus ratios.
Why does my NSE price series show a 50% drop on a stock's split date?

negative.prompt: How do I build point-in-time Nifty 50 membership from NSE index-change press releases?
What does an intraday NSE trade cost including STT and stamp duty?

evals.prompt: My script downloads cm<DDMONYYYY>bhav.csv.zip from the NSE archives every day. It has returned nothing since mid-2024. Why?
expectations: Says the legacy bhavcopy was discontinued (last file 5 Jul 2024)
Says the CM-UDiFF common bhavcopy replaced it from 8 Jul 2024

evals.prompt: When I back-adjust for a split, should prices on the ex-date itself be adjusted, i.e. date <= exDate?
expectations: Says adjust strictly before the ex-date (date < exDate)
Says the ex-date bar already trades at the new scale; compare dates, not timestamps

evals.prompt: An NSE subject reads 'Face Value Split (Sub-Division) - From Rs 10/- Per Share To Rs 2/- Per Share'. What factor do I multiply pre-split prices by?
expectations: Gives 0.2 (new face value over old), not 5

evals.prompt: A corporate-action subject reads 'Bonus 1:1 And Face Value Split From Rs.2/- To Re.1/-'. My parser types it as SPLIT. Is that fine?
expectations: Says it is two price events on one ex-date and needs a compound type carrying both ratios
Says typing it as SPLIT alone understates the adjustment by 2x
Notes the singular Re. for one rupee must be parsed

evals.prompt: My bhavcopy-derived dataset has delivery quantity 0 for every day in 2015. Is that just low delivery?
expectations: Says delivery data does not exist before 30 Sep 2019
Says unavailable fields must be emitted empty, never 0

evals.prompt: Should my NSE price-history pipeline adjust prices for ordinary dividends and for rights issues by default, like total-return adjusted closes?
expectations: Says ordinary dividends stay raw in the price series
Says rights are not adjusted by default, because a share-count ratio overstates a discounted, subscription-dependent event
